title: Plan / Task Review Suggestions
description: The JSON array `review-plan` and `review-tasks` ask each model for. Transcribed verbatim from the shipped prompt contracts (prompts/plan_review.txt and prompts/task_review.txt, whose 'Output Format' sections are byte-identical in field set, enum values and the 'exactly these fields' rule) — it is NOT an invented shape. One file serves both phases because the document is the same document; splitting it would create two copies free to drift. `format_version` is carried as a schema-level annotation rather than a document property because the document is an array and has nowhere in-band to put one (consolidated.schema.json, an object, carries its own as a property).

desc.description: Text explaining the issue, in the form the phase's prompt asks for

reference.description: Which section of the plan this affects (review-plan), or the task id / plan section (review-tasks)
